summaries.title: RAD-2: Scaling Reinforcement Learning in a Generator-Discriminator Framework
summaries.organization: Huazhong University of Science and Technology
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**训练与强化学习**（Training & RL）赛道，属于系统与工程框架。针对当前领域面临的「强化学习信用分配困难与训练不稳定性、安全对齐脆弱性、隐私版权与潜在失控风险」痛点，作者围绕 **RAD-2** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖群组相对策略优化（Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)）。核心论点主张：To address these issues, we propose RAD-2, a unified generator-discriminator framework for closed-loop planning。
